caption: Van Gogh Church, Nuenen
composition: Small 1824 brick hall church and open roof turret in a churchyard · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Van Gogh church in Nuenen is the small 1824 hall church on Papenvoort, with an open wooden roof turret and a short spire, standing in a leafy churchyard. It is not the medieval tower Van Gogh painted, which was later taken down, and it is not a painting. The church is closed. The sky is clear, about 11.8°C, with wind near 10.8 km/h. Sunset was 19:27. Trees are still in leaf.
